quests.instruction: Which shape matches a card you might give someone you love?
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: Think of a shape with a dip at the top and a point at the bottom.
quests.explanation: This card shape has a curved dip at the top and comes to a point below, just like a heart!
quests.funFact: The heart shape is a favorite symbol for showing love and kindness.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a colorful kite dancing high in the wind?
quests.question: Diamond
quests.hint: Think of a shape like a square standing up on one of its corners.
quests.explanation: This kite has four sides meeting at points on top, bottom, left, and right, just like a diamond!
quests.funFact: A diamond shape is a square that has been turned to stand on one corner.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a thin curved moon glowing at night?
quests.question: Crescent
quests.hint: Think of a shape like a circle with a bite taken out of one side.
quests.explanation: This moon is curved on the outside with a scoop taken from the inside, just like a crescent!
quests.funFact: A crescent moon appears when we can only see a slim curved sliver of the moon lit by the sun.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a round trampoline set up in a backyard?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of a shape that curves evenly all the way around.
quests.explanation: A trampoline is round all over with no straight edges, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: Round trampolines let jumpers bounce safely no matter which direction they land.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches two cherries growing side by side on a stem?
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: Think of a shape with two rounded bumps that meet in a point below.
quests.explanation: Two cherries together curve inward at the top and meet at a point, just like a heart!
quests.funFact: Artists often draw hearts using two curved bumps joined at a bottom point.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a single patch on a quilt blanket?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape shaped like a tiny, perfectly even block.
quests.explanation: This quilt patch has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: Quilts are often made of many small squares sewn together in neat rows.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches the diamond suit printed on a playing card?
quests.question: Diamond
quests.hint: Think of a shape with a point at the top, bottom, left, and right.
quests.explanation: This card symbol has four points arranged top, bottom, left, and right, just like a diamond!
quests.funFact: Playing cards use the diamond shape as one of the four card suits.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a wedge of orange peeled apart?
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with three sides that come together at one point.
quests.explanation: An orange wedge narrows to a point with three straight-ish sides, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Cutting round fruit into wedges often creates little triangle shapes.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a curved banana resting in a fruit bowl?
quests.question: Crescent
quests.hint: Think of a shape that curves like a smile, thicker in the middle.
quests.explanation: A banana curves gently like a smile, just like a crescent!
quests.funFact: Crescent shapes curve smoothly with pointed tips on both ends.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a candy bar wrapper before it's opened?
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape longer on two sides than the other two.
quests.explanation: A candy wrapper is longer than it is wide, with four corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Long snack wrappers are almost always shaped like rectangles.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a strawberry viewed from the top down?
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: Think of a shape rounded on top with a single point below.
quests.explanation: A strawberry is rounded at the top and narrows to a point, just like a heart!
quests.funFact: Many fruits are named after the heart shape because of how their outline curves.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a firework bursting in the night sky?
quests.question: Star
quests.hint: Think of a shape with points shooting outward in every direction.
quests.explanation: A firework burst spreads points outward from the center, just like a star!
quests.funFact: Fireworks are often designed to burst into a star pattern in the sky.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a race track viewed from above?
quests.question: Oval
quests.hint: Think of a shape like a stretched circle with two curved ends.
quests.explanation: A race track curves all around but is longer than it is wide, just like an oval!
quests.funFact: Oval tracks let racers zoom around two long curves and two short ones.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a flaky croissant fresh from the bakery?
quests.question: Crescent
quests.hint: Think of a shape curved into a smile with two pointed ends.
quests.explanation: A croissant curves into a smile shape with two pointed tips, just like a crescent!
quests.funFact: Bakers curl croissant dough into a crescent shape before baking.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a sparkling gem set in a ring?
quests.question: Diamond
quests.hint: Think of a shape like a square tipped up to stand on its corner.
quests.explanation: A gem cut like this has four points top, bottom, left, and right, just like a diamond!
quests.funFact: Many gemstones are cut into a diamond shape to catch and sparkle the light.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a balloon shaped for a love-themed party?
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: Think of a shape with two soft curves on top and a point below.
quests.explanation: This balloon curves inward at the top and meets at a point below, just like a heart!
quests.funFact: Heart balloons are a popular choice for celebrations about love and friendship.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a single stamp on an envelope?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape where every side is the exact same length.
quests.explanation: This stamp has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: Many postage stamps are printed as neat little squares.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a thin sliver of melon cut from the edge?
quests.question: Crescent
quests.hint: Think of a shape curved on the outside with a scoop on the inside.
quests.explanation: This melon sliver curves outward with a hollow curve inside, just like a crescent!
quests.funFact: A crescent always has two pointed tips where its curves meet.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a target board used for throwing darts?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of a shape made of rings that all curve around one center point.
quests.explanation: A dartboard is made of circles, all round with no corners, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: Circles are perfect for targets because every point on the edge is equally far from the middle.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a baseball infield when you look down from above?
quests.question: Diamond
quests.hint: Think of a shape like a square standing tall on one point.
quests.explanation: A baseball infield has four bases arranged like the points of a diamond!
quests.funFact: Baseball fields are often called "diamonds" because of this exact shape.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a folded paper airplane nose?
quests.question: Triangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape that narrows from a wide base to a sharp point.
quests.explanation: A paper airplane nose narrows to one sharp point, just like a triangle!
quests.funFact: Triangle-shaped noses help paper airplanes slice smoothly through the air.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a shiny ornament hung on a holiday tree?
quests.question: Star
quests.hint: Think of a shape with several points spreading outward evenly.
quests.explanation: This ornament has points spreading out from its center, just like a star!
quests.funFact: Stars are a favorite shape for tree toppers during winter celebrations.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a bar of soap sitting on the sink?
quests.question: Rectangle
quests.hint: Think of a shape with four corners, longer on two sides than the other two.
quests.explanation: A bar of soap is longer than it is wide, with four corners, just like a rectangle!
quests.funFact: Rectangles are an easy shape to hold comfortably in your hand.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a fresh green leaf plucked from a plant?
quests.question: Oval
quests.hint: Think of a shape that curves smoothly but is longer than it is wide.
quests.explanation: Many leaves curve smoothly and are longer than they are wide, just like an oval!
quests.funFact: Leaf shapes can be oval, heart-shaped, or even star-shaped depending on the plant.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a locket necklace opened to show a photo?
quests.question: Heart
quests.hint: Think of a shape with a curved dip at the top, like two little hills.
quests.explanation: This locket dips at the top and meets in a point below, just like a heart!
quests.funFact: Heart-shaped lockets are a classic gift for close friends and family.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a boomerang before it's thrown?
quests.question: Crescent
quests.hint: Think of a shape curved like a smile with two ends pointing the same way.
quests.explanation: A boomerang curves like a smile with two pointed ends, just like a crescent!
quests.funFact: Crescent-curved boomerangs are designed to fly in a big loop and come back.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a single Scrabble game tile?
quests.question: Square
quests.hint: Think of a shape with four equal sides, like a tiny even block.
quests.explanation: A game tile like this has four equal sides and four corners, just like a square!
quests.funFact: Board game tiles are often squares because they line up neatly in a grid.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a yellow road sign warning drivers ahead?
quests.question: Diamond
quests.hint: Think of a shape standing tall on one pointed corner.
quests.explanation: Warning signs like this stand on one point with four sides, just like a diamond!
quests.funFact: Many road warning signs use a diamond shape so drivers notice them quickly.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a porthole window on a big ship?
quests.question: Circle
quests.hint: Think of a shape that is round with a smooth curved edge all around.
quests.explanation: A porthole window is round all the way around, just like a circle!
quests.funFact: Round portholes are stronger against ocean waves than sharp-cornered windows.

quests.instruction: Which shape matches a starfish resting on the sandy beach?
quests.question: Star
quests.hint: Think of a shape with arms reaching outward like points.
quests.explanation: A starfish has arms that reach outward like points, just like a star!
quests.funFact: Most starfish have five arms, matching the five points of a classic star shape.
